sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Dressing is a way of life.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: read about how to choose the right colours to wear;
sentences.ipa: /ˈred əˈbaʊt ˌhaʊ tə ˈtʃuːz ðə ˈraɪt ˈkʌləz tə ˈweə;/
sentences.meaning: 阅读如何选择适合自己穿着的颜色；

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: get to know about different types of clothes;
sentences.ipa: /get tə ˈnəʊ əˈbaʊt ˈdɪfərənt ˈtaɪps ɒv ˈkləʊðz;/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: learn about the culture behind clothes.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It is the Fashion Week at Sunshine Middle School.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɪt ɪz ðə ˈfæʃən ˈwiːk æt ˈsʌnʃaɪn ˈmɪdəl ˈskuːl./
sentences.meaning: 今天是阳光中学时尚周。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Let’s talk about our favourite colours and ways of dressing.
sentences.ipa: /ˈlets ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ˌaʊə ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈkʌləz ænd ˈweɪz ɒv ˈdresɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 让我们来谈谈我们最喜欢的颜色和着装方式。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Look at the pictures and write down what they are wearing in the boxes.
sentences.ipa: /ˈlʊk æt ðə ˈpɪktʃəz ænd ˈraɪt ˌdaʊn ˌwɒt ðeɪ ɑː ˈweərɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈbɒksɪz./
sentences.meaning: 看看这些照片，写下他们在盒子里穿的是什么。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A The Class 1, Grade 7 students are ready for a school fashion show.
sentences.ipa: /ə ðə ˈklɑːs ˈwʌn, ˈgreɪd ˈsevən ˈstjuːdnts ɑː ˈrediː fɔː ə ˈskuːl ˈfæʃən ˈʃəʊ./
sentences.meaning: A班1年级，7年级学生准备参加学校时装秀。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Work in pairs and talk about the topic.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwɜːk ɪn ˈpeəz ænd ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈtɒpɪk./
sentences.meaning: 成对地工作，谈论这个话题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Sandy and Simon are talking about their favourite colours.
sentences.ipa: /ˈbiː ˈsændiː ænd saɪmən ɑː ˈtɔːkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðeə ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈkʌləz./
sentences.meaning: B Sandy和Simon在谈论他们最喜欢的颜色。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the conversation below as a model.
sentences.ipa: /ˈjuːz ðə ˌkɒnvəˈseɪʃən bɪˈləʊ æz ə ˈmɒdəl./

sentences.speaker: sandy
sentences.text: What colours do you like for your clothes, Simon?
sentences.ipa: /ˌwɒt ˈkʌləz ˈduː juː ˈlaɪk fɔː jɔː ˈkləʊðz, saɪmən?/
sentences.meaning: 你喜欢什么颜色的衣服，西蒙？

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: I like warm colours like red and orange. They make me feel happy.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ˈlaɪk ˈwɔːm ˈkʌləz ˈlaɪk ˈred ænd ˈɒrɪndʒ. ˌðeɪ ˌmeɪk ˌmiː ˈfiːl ˈhæpiː./
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢红色和橙色等温暖的颜色，它们让我感到快乐。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: What are your favourite colours, Sandy?
sentences.meaning: 你最喜欢什么颜色，桑迪？

sentences.speaker: sandy
sentences.text: I love cool colours like blue. They make me feel calm.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ˈlʌv ˈkuːl ˈkʌləz ˈlaɪk ˈbluː. ˌðeɪ ˌmeɪk ˌmiː ˈfiːl ˈkɑːm./
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢像蓝色一样的凉爽的颜色，它们让我感到冷静。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C There is a fashion show at your school.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsiː ˌðeə ɪz ə ˈfæʃən ˈʃəʊ æt jɔː ˈskuːl./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What do you want to wear for it?
sentences.ipa: /ˌwɒt ˈduː juː ˈwɒnt tə ˈweə fɔː ɪt?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Sunshine Middle School invited Ms Li, a fashion designer, to advise students on choosing the right colour to wear.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsʌnʃaɪn ˈmɪdəl ˈskuːl ɪˈnvaɪtɪd ˈliː, ə ˈfæʃən dɪˈzaɪnə, tʊ əˈdvaɪz ˈstjuːdnts ˌɒn ˈtʃuːzɪŋ ðə ˈraɪt ˈkʌlə tə ˈweə./
sentences.meaning: 阳光中学校邀请时装设计师李女士，建议学生选择合适的颜色穿戴。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before reading, think about the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /bɪˈfɔː ˈriːdɪŋ, ˈθɪŋk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈkwestʃənz bɪˈləʊ./
sentences.meaning: 在阅读前，考虑下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Do you think colour matching is important?
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˈduː juː ˈθɪŋk ˈkʌlə ˈmætʃɪŋ ɪz ɪˈmpɔːtənt?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 What questions about colours do you have for a fashion designer?
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˌwɒt ˈkwestʃənz əˈbaʊt ˈkʌləz ˈduː juː hæv fɔː ə ˈfæʃən dɪˈzaɪnə?/
sentences.meaning: 2你对时装设计师有什么问题？

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: Good morning, Ms Li. May I ask you some questions about colours in fashion?
sentences.ipa: /ˈgʊd ˈmɔːnɪŋ, ˈliː. ˈmeɪ ˌaɪ ˈɑːsk juː ˌsʌm ˈkwestʃənz əˈbaʊt ˈkʌləz ɪn ˈfæʃən?/
sentences.meaning: 早上好，李小姐我能问你一些时尚颜色的问题吗？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We may better understand a text with the help of words like such as, for example or in fact.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː ˈmeɪ ˈbetə ˌʌndəˈstænd ə ˈtekst wɪð ðə ˈhelp ɒv ˈwɜːdz ˈlaɪk ˈsʌtʃ æz, fɔː ɪˈgzɑːmpəl ɔː ɪn ˈfækt./
sentences.meaning: 我们也许在诸如此类的文字帮助下，或者在事实上，能够更好地理解案文。

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: How can we choose the right colours to wear? Could you give us some advice?
sentences.ipa: /ˌhaʊ kæn wiː ˈtʃuːz ðə ˈraɪt ˈkʌləz tə ˈweə? ˌkʊd juː ˈgɪv ˌʌs ˌsʌm əˈdvaɪs?/
sentences.meaning: 我们如何选择合适的颜色？请给我们一些建议。

sentences.speaker: ms li
sentences.text: Well, it depends on the colour of our skin. Some people look good in warm colours, like yellow, red and orange, but other people look nice in cool colours, such as green, blue and purple.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwel, ɪt dɪˈpendz ˌɒn ðə ˈkʌlə ɒv ˌaʊə ˈskɪn. ˌsʌm ˈpiːpəl ˈlʊk ˈgʊd ɪn ˈwɔːm ˈkʌləz, ˈlaɪk ˈjeləʊ, ˈred ænd ˈɒrɪndʒ, ˌbʌt ˈʌðə ˈpiːpəl ˈlʊk ˈnaɪs ɪn ˈkuːl ˈkʌləz, ˈsʌtʃ æz ˈgriːn, ˈbluː ænd ˈpɜːpəl./
sentences.meaning: 这取决于我们皮肤的颜色。有些人在温暖的颜色中看起来不错，比如黄色，红色和橙色，但其他人在凉爽的颜色中看起来不错，比如绿色，蓝色和紫色。

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.meaning: 哪种颜色在一起很合适？

sentences.speaker: ms li
sentences.text: Try to pick similar colours. For example, wear dark blue jeans with a light blue blouse or T-shirt.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtraɪ tə ˈpɪk ˈsɪmɪlə ˈkʌləz. ˌfɔː ɪˈgzɑːmpəl, ˈweə ˈdɑːk ˈbluː ˈdʒiːnz wɪð ə ˈlaɪt ˈbluː ˈblaʊz ɔː ˈtiːʃɜːt./
sentences.meaning: 尝试选择相似的颜色，例如穿着深蓝色牛仔裤，穿着浅蓝色的衬衫或T恤。

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: OK, but can we mix warm and cool colours?
sentences.ipa: /ˌəʊˈkeɪ, ˌbʌt kæn wiː ˈmɪks ˈwɔːm ænd ˈkuːl ˈkʌləz?/
sentences.meaning: 好吧，但我们可以混合 温暖和凉爽的颜色？

sentences.speaker: ms li
sentences.text: Yes. In fact, warm and cool colours make each other stand out, such as yellow and green or orange and blue. But don’t wear more than three colours at one time.
sentences.ipa: /ˈjes. ɪn ˈfækt, ˈwɔːm ænd ˈkuːl ˈkʌləz ˌmeɪk ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə ˈstænd ˈaʊt, ˈsʌtʃ æz ˈjeləʊ ænd ˈgriːn ɔː ˈɒrɪndʒ ænd ˈbluː. ˌbʌt ˈdəʊnt ˈweə ˈmɔː ðən ˈθriː ˈkʌləz æt ˈwʌn ˈtaɪm./
sentences.meaning: 是的，事实上，温暖和凉爽的颜色让彼此引人注目，比如黄色和绿色，或橙色和蓝色。但一次不要穿超过3种颜色。

sentences.speaker: ms li
sentences.text: Black, white and grey go well with any colour. They’re suitable for both formal suits and casual clothes.
sentences.ipa: /ˈblæk, ˈwaɪt ænd ˈgreɪ ˌgəʊ ˈwel wɪð ˈeniː ˈkʌlə. ˌðeə ˈsuːtəbəl fɔː ˈbəʊθ ˈfɔːməl ˈsuːts ænd ˈkæʒʊəl ˈkləʊðz./
sentences.meaning: 黑色、白色和灰色都配有颜色。它们既适合正式的服饰，也适合临时的服饰。

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: Thanks for your advice, Ms Li.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Kitty is making some notes about Ms Li’s talk.
sentences.ipa: /ə ˈkɪtiː ɪz ˈmeɪkɪŋ ˌsʌm ˈnəʊts əˈbaʊt ˈliːz ˈtɔːk./
sentences.meaning: 一个小猫咪正在做一些关于李女士的谈话的笔记。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Write a T if a sentence is true or an F if it is false.
sentences.ipa: /ˈraɪt ə ˈtiː ɪf ə ˈsentəns ɪz ˈtruː ɔː ən ˈef ɪf ɪt ɪz ˈfɔːls./
sentences.meaning: 如果句子是真的，写个T，如果句子是假的，写一个F。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Read the interview script again.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Ms Li knows a lot about colours in fashion.
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˈliː ˈnəʊz ə ˈlɒt əˈbaʊt ˈkʌləz ɪn ˈfæʃən./
sentences.meaning: 1，李小姐对时尚色彩了解甚多。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 Both orange and green are warm colours.
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˈbəʊθ ˈɒrɪndʒ ænd ˈgriːn ɑː ˈwɔːm ˈkʌləz./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 Dark blue trousers do not go well with a blue T-shirt.
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˈdɑːk ˈbluː ˈtraʊzəz ˈduː ˌnɒt ˌgəʊ ˈwel wɪð ə ˈbluː ˈtiːʃɜːt./
sentences.meaning: 3 深蓝色的裤子 穿蓝色T恤不好

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 People should wear more than three colours at one time.
sentences.ipa: /ˈfɔː ˈpiːpəl ˌʃʊd ˈweə ˈmɔː ðən ˈθriː ˈkʌləz æt ˈwʌn ˈtaɪm./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 Green and yellow go together well.
sentences.ipa: /ˈfaɪv ˈgriːn ænd ˈjeləʊ ˌgəʊ təˈgeðə ˈwel./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 6 Grey is a good colour for both casual and formal clothes.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsɪks ˈgreɪ ɪz ə ˈgʊd ˈkʌlə fɔː ˈbəʊθ ˈkæʒʊəl ænd ˈfɔːməl ˈkləʊðz./
sentences.meaning: 6 Grey对临时服装和正规服装都是很好的颜色。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete her article with the correct forms of the words and phrases in the box below.
sentences.ipa: /kəˈmpliːt hɜː ˈɑːtɪkəl wɪð ðə kəˈrekt ˈfɔːmz ɒv ðə ˈwɜːdz ænd ˈfreɪzɪz ɪn ðə ˈbɒks bɪˈləʊ./
sentences.meaning: 在她的文章中填写下框中的正确文字和短语形式。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Ms Li is writing some advice about dressing for special days.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsiː ˈliː ɪz ˈraɪtɪŋ ˌsʌm əˈdvaɪs əˈbaʊt ˈdresɪŋ fɔː ˈspeʃl ˈdeɪz./
sentences.meaning: C李小姐正在写一些关于特别日穿衣的建议。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: On special days, you need to wear the right clothes.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɒn ˈspeʃl ˈdeɪz, juː ˈniːd tə ˈweə ðə ˈraɪt ˈkləʊðz./
sentences.meaning: 在特殊的日子，你需要穿正确的衣服。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: about getting dressed on these days.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: For a school field trip, you should wear comfortable clothes and
sentences.ipa: /ˌfɔː ə ˈskuːl ˈfiːld ˈtrɪp, juː ˌʃʊd ˈweə ˈkʌmfətəbəl ˈkləʊðz ænd/
sentences.meaning: 校外旅行时，您应该穿着舒适的衣服，

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: shoes, like a T-shirt, jeans and sports shoes.
sentences.ipa: /ˈʃuːz, ˈlaɪk ə ˈtiːʃɜːt, ˈdʒiːnz ænd ˈspɔːts ˈʃuːz./
sentences.meaning: 鞋子，如T恤，牛仔裤和运动鞋。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Do not wear skirts or dresses.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: To go to a formal event, you should some nice
sentences.ipa: /tə ˌgəʊ tə ə ˈfɔːməl ɪˈvent, juː ˌʃʊd ˌsʌm ˈnaɪs/
sentences.meaning: 要参加一个正式的活动，你应该一些好

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It is best not to two quite different colours.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɪt ɪz ˈbest ˌnɒt tə ˈtuː ˈkwaɪt ˈdɪfərənt ˈkʌləz./
sentences.meaning: 最好不要有两种完全不同的颜色。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: You can wear clothes of colours.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: green blouse and a dark green skirt each other.
sentences.ipa: /ˈgriːn ˈblaʊz ænd ə ˈdɑːk ˈgriːn ˈskɜːt ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðə./
sentences.meaning: 绿色的上衣和深绿色的裙子彼此。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: can also wear a or a dress.
sentences.ipa: /kæn ˈɔːlsəʊ ˈweə ə ɔː ə ˈdres./
sentences.meaning: 也可以穿一件或一件礼服。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D Think about the questions below.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Share your answers with your classmates.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Which piece of advice from Ms Li do you think is the most useful?
sentences.ipa: /ˈwʌn ˌwɪtʃ ˈpiːs ɒv əˈdvaɪs frɒm ˈliː ˈduː juː ˈθɪŋk ɪz ðə ˈməʊst ˈjuːsfʊl?/
sentences.meaning: 1，你认为李女士的哪些建议最有用？。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 Do you look better in warm colours or cool colours?
sentences.ipa: /ˈtuː ˈduː juː ˈlʊk ˈbetə ɪn ˈwɔːm ˈkʌləz ɔː ˈkuːl ˈkʌləz?/
sentences.meaning: 2，在温暖的颜色或凉爽的颜色中你看起来更好看吗？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 What other advice do you have about fashion?
sentences.ipa: /ˈθriː ˌwɒt ˈʌðə əˈdvaɪs ˈduː juː hæv əˈbaʊt ˈfæʃən?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Pay attention to the three question types.
sentences.ipa: /ˈpeɪ əˈtenʃən tə ðə ˈθriː ˈkwestʃən ˈtaɪps./

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.text: Do you have a talk with Ms Li before the show?
sentences.ipa: /ˈduː juː hæv ə ˈtɔːk wɪð ˈliː bɪˈfɔː ðə ˈʃəʊ?/
sentences.meaning: 演出前你有没有跟李小姐谈过话？

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: Yes. It’s about colours in fashion.
sentences.meaning: 是的，这是关于时尚的颜色。

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: No. She’s a fashion designer. When we answer a question with yes or no, we call it a yes-no question.
sentences.ipa: /ˈnəʊ. ˌʃiːz ə ˈfæʃən dɪˈzaɪnə. ˌwen wiː ˈɑːnsə ə ˈkwestʃən wɪð ˈjes ɔː ˈnəʊ, wiː ˈkɔːl ɪt ə ˌjeˈsnəʊ ˈkwestʃən./
sentences.meaning: 不，她是一个时装设计师。当我们回答一个“是”或“否”的问题时，我们称之为“是”或“否 ” 。

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.text: When is the fashion show, by the way?
sentences.ipa: /ˌwen ɪz ðə ˈfæʃən ˈʃəʊ, baɪ ðə ˈweɪ?/
sentences.meaning: 顺便说一下，时装秀是什么时候？

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.text: Where does the show take place?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A wh-question begins with a question word.
sentences.ipa: /ə ˈkwestʃən bɪˈgɪnz wɪð ə ˈkwestʃən ˈwɜːd./
sentences.meaning: 一个Wh -质询开始一个质询词。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We need more information to answer a wh-question.
sentences.ipa: /ˌwiː ˈniːd ˈmɔː ˌɪnfəˈmeɪʃən tʊ ˈɑːnsə ə ˈkwestʃən./
sentences.meaning: 我们需要更多的信息来回答一个问题。

sentences.speaker: daniel
sentences.text: Is your favourite colour a warm colour or a cool colour?
sentences.ipa: /ˌɪz jɔː ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈkʌlə ə ˈwɔːm ˈkʌlə ɔː ə ˈkuːl ˈkʌlə?/
sentences.meaning: 你最喜欢的颜色是温暖的还是凉爽的颜色？

sentences.speaker: kitty

sentences.ipa: /ɑː ˈjuːʒʊəliː ˌmeɪd ɒv ˈsɪlk, ænd ðeɪ ˈfiːl ˈsmuːð ænd ˈsɒft. ˈsʌmtaɪmz ðeə ˌmeɪd ɒv ˈkɒtən. ˌaɪ ˈθɪŋk ˈɔːl ˈwɪmɪn, ˈjʌŋ ɔː ˈəʊld, ˈlʊk ˈbjuːtɪfʊl ˈɪn ə./
sentences.meaning: 齐宝通常由丝绸制成，它们会感觉光滑和柔软。有时它们会用棉花制成。我认为所有年轻或年长的妇女都穿着齐宝装美观。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: is used to express agreement while also presenting a different point of view.
sentences.ipa: /ɪz ˈjuːzd tʊ ɪˈkspres əˈgriːmənt ˌwaɪl ˈɔːlsəʊ prɪˈzentɪŋ ə ˈdɪfərənt ˈpɔɪnt ɒv ˈvjuː./
sentences.meaning: 用于表达一致意见，同时提出不同的观点。

sentences.speaker: sandy
sentences.text: Yes, I agree, but I like hanfu most. They’re usually loose and comfortable to wear.
sentences.ipa: /ˈjes, ˌaɪ əˈgriː, ˌbʌt ˌaɪ ˈlaɪk ˈməʊst. ˌðeə ˈjuːʒʊəliː ˈluːs ænd ˈkʌmfətəbəl tə ˈweə./
sentences.meaning: 是的，我同意，但我最喜欢汉福。他们通常穿着松散舒适。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D The Class 1, Grade 7 students want to make a “Fashion Wall” in their classroom.
sentences.ipa: /ˈdiː ðə ˈklɑːs ˈwʌn, ˈgreɪd ˈsevən ˈstjuːdnts ˈwɒnt tə ˌmeɪk ə “ˈfæʃən ˈwɔːl” ɪn ðeə ˈklɑːsruːm./
sentences.meaning: D.一年级7年级学生希望在课堂上建造“时尚墙”。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Each student is going to design an outfit for daily wear and write an article about it.
sentences.ipa: /ˈiːtʃ ˈstjuːdnt ɪz ˈgəʊɪŋ tə dɪˈzaɪn ən ˈaʊtfɪt fɔː ˈdeɪliː ˈweə ænd ˈraɪt ən ˈɑːtɪkəl əˈbaʊt ɪt./
sentences.meaning: 每个学生将设计一套日常穿戴的服饰，并写一篇关于它的文章。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D1 Look at Sandy’s plan with pictures below.
sentences.ipa: /ˈdiː ˈwʌn ˈlʊk æt ˈsændiːz ˈplæn wɪð ˈpɪktʃəz bɪˈləʊ./
sentences.meaning: D1用下面的照片看桑迪的计划。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D2 Read Sandy’s article about her fashion design.
sentences.ipa: /ˈdiː ˈtuː ˈriːd ˈsændiːz ˈɑːtɪkəl əˈbaʊt hɜː ˈfæʃən dɪˈzaɪn./
sentences.meaning: D2 Read Sandy关于她时装设计的文章。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Here is my design for a shirt, a jacket, a pair of jeans and a pair of sports shoes.
sentences.ipa: /ˈhɪə ɪz maɪ dɪˈzaɪn fɔː ə ˈʃɜːt, ə ˈdʒækɪt, ə ˈpeə ɒv ˈdʒiːnz ænd ə ˈpeə ɒv ˈspɔːts ˈʃuːz./
sentences.meaning: 这是我的衬衫、夹克、牛仔裤和运动鞋的设计。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I think white shirts have a clean look, and white matches any other colour.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ˈθɪŋk ˈwaɪt ˈʃɜːts hæv ə ˈkliːn ˈlʊk, ænd ˈwaɪt ˈmætʃɪz ˈeniː ˈʌðə ˈkʌlə./
sentences.meaning: 我认为白色衬衫有干净的外观，白色与任何其他颜色相匹配。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The jacket is not too long or too large, and it is dark blue.
sentences.ipa: /ðə ˈdʒækɪt ɪz ˌnɒt ˈtuː ˈlɒŋ ɔː ˈtuː ˈlɑːdʒ, ænd ɪt ɪz ˈdɑːk ˈbluː./
sentences.meaning: 外套不是太长或太大，是深蓝色的。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Students look smart in dark blue.
sentences.meaning: 学生在深蓝色中看起来很聪明。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Jeans are very popular with students, so my design has a pair of blue jeans.
sentences.ipa: /ˈdʒiːnz ɑː ˈveriː ˈpɒpjʊlə wɪð ˈstjuːdnts, ˌsəʊ maɪ dɪˈzaɪn hæz ə ˈpeə ɒv ˈbluː ˈdʒiːnz./
sentences.meaning: 牛仔裤很受学生欢迎，所以我的设计有一套蓝色牛仔裤。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The shirt, the jacket and the jeans are all made of cotton and are very comfortable.
sentences.ipa: /ðə ˈʃɜːt, ðə ˈdʒækɪt ænd ðə ˈdʒiːnz ɑː ˈɔːl ˌmeɪd ɒv ˈkɒtən ænd ɑː ˈveriː ˈkʌmfətəbəl./
sentences.meaning: 衬衫，夹克和牛仔裤都用棉花制成，非常舒适。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: There is also a pair of sports shoes.
sentences.ipa: /ˌðeə ɪz ˈɔːlsəʊ ə ˈpeə ɒv ˈspɔːts ˈʃuːz./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: They are grey and made of leather.
sentences.ipa: /ˌðeɪ ɑː ˈgreɪ ænd ˌmeɪd ɒv ˈleðə./
sentences.meaning: 它们是灰色的，用皮革做的。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Sports shoes are light and good for sport, and all the students like them.
sentences.ipa: /ˈspɔːts ˈʃuːz ɑː ˈlaɪt ænd ˈgʊd fɔː ˈspɔːt, ænd ˈɔːl ðə ˈstjuːdnts ˈlaɪk ˌðem./
sentences.meaning: 运动鞋轻而易举，有利于运动，所有学生都喜欢运动鞋。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: All of these come in different sizes.
sentences.ipa: /ˈɔːl ɒv ðiːz ˈkʌm ɪn ˈdɪfərənt ˈsaɪzɪz./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Make a writing plan like the one in Part D1.
sentences.ipa: /ˌmeɪk ə ˈraɪtɪŋ ˈplæn ˈlaɪk ðə ˈwʌn ɪn ˈpɑːt ˈdiː ˈwʌn./
sentences.meaning: 做一个像D1部分的写作计划。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D3 Write an article about your fashion design.
sentences.ipa: /ˈdiː ˈθriː ˈraɪt ən ˈɑːtɪkəl əˈbaʊt jɔː ˈfæʃən dɪˈzaɪn./
sentences.meaning: D3写一篇关于你时装设计的文章。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use Sandy’s article as a model.

sentences.ipa: /ˌmaɪ ˈdʒækɪt ɪz ˈlaɪt ænd ˈkʌmfətəbəl ˈθɪk ænd ˈwɔːm./
sentences.meaning: 我的夹克又轻又舒服又暖和

sentences.meaning: 3，我可以用这个单位的新字来谈论和写衣服。

sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ kæn prəˈnaʊns ðə ˈsaʊndz ˌiːˈaɪ, ˌeɪˈaɪ, ˈɔɪ, ˌɑːˈdʌbəljuː, ˌeɪˈdʌbəljuː,/

sentences.ipa: /əˈses jɔː ˈlɜːnɪŋ ɒv ˈnjuː ˈwɜːdz ænd ˈgræmə baɪ ˈduːɪŋ ðiː ˈeksəsaɪzɪz ˌɒn ˈpeɪdʒ ˈwʌn ˈhʌndrəd ˈtwentiː ˈwʌn./
